capabilities: create a same-named Markdown note next to a selected non-Markdown file
insert a link to the source file in the new note
open the note in a chosen pane via a command-palette command
open an existing note without modifying it after confirmation
disambiguation: Not a file converter; it creates an empty Markdown note containing a link to the source file and never modifies that file.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README covers pane-selection behavior and error cases in detail but includes no screenshots.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to spawn a companion note for a PDF or other non-Markdown file directly from the file explorer.
summary: File-explorer and command-palette helper that creates a same-named Markdown note next to a non-Markdown file and links back to it.
